instruction_zh: 构建一个叉车补货场景：rack放在作业区后方，pallet位于rack的左后方并与货架保持短距离，forklift停在pallet前方准备叉取，box放在pallet上，box放在rack的中层货位。 设置支撑关系：box（箱体）由pallet（托盘）支撑；box（箱体）由rack（货架）支撑。 场景整体布置在主通道左侧。
instruction_en: Create a forklift replenishment scene: place rack at the rear of the work area, put pallet on the rear-left side of rack with a short gap to the rack, park forklift in front of pallet for pickup, place box on pallet, and place box on the middle bay of rack. instruction_zh: 构建一个输送线分拣场景：conveyor平行于货架通道布置，Industrialrobot位于conveyor的右后方负责抓取，part放在conveyor表面，pallet位于conveyor出料端右后方，workbench放在Industrialrobot的另一侧作为检验台。 设置支撑关系：part（零件）由conveyor（输送线）支撑。 场景整体布置在主通道左侧。
instruction_en: Create a conveyor sorting scene: arrange conveyor in an parallel to the rack aisle orientation, put Industrialrobot on the rear-right side of conveyor for picking, place part on the surface of conveyor, put pallet on the rear-right side of the outfeed end, and place workbench on the other side of Industrialrobot as an inspection table. instruction_zh: 构建一个人工检验工位：workbench放在场景中央，rack位于workbench的正前方用于暂存物料，part和box都放在workbench上，agv停在rack前方等待取走箱体，使工作台前方留出人员操作空间。 设置支撑关系：part（零件）由workbench（工作台）支撑；box（箱体）由workbench（工作台）支撑。 场景整体布置在主通道左侧。
instruction_en: Create a manual inspection workstation: place workbench in the center of the scene, put rack on the front side of workbench for temporary storage, place both part and box on workbench, with agv waiting in front of rack, and keep operator space in front of the bench. instruction_zh: 构建一个人工检验工位：workbench放在场景中央，rack位于workbench的左后方用于暂存物料，box放在rack下层，part放在workbench上，使工作台前方留出人员操作空间。 设置支撑关系：part（零件）由workbench（工作台）支撑；box（箱体）由rack（货架）支撑。 场景整体布置在主通道右侧。
instruction_en: Create a manual inspection workstation: place workbench in the center of the scene, put rack on the rear-left side of workbench for temporary storage, place box on the lower shelf of rack and part on workbench, and keep operator space in front of the bench. Set support relations: part is supported by workbench; box is supported by rack. Place the whole scene on the right side of the main aisle.

instruction_zh: 构建一个AGV与输送线交接场景：conveyor沿东西方向放置，pallet位于conveyor入料端的右后方，box放在pallet上，part放在conveyor上，agv停在pallet外侧并朝向输送线。 设置支撑关系：box（箱体）由pallet（托盘）支撑；part（零件）由conveyor（输送线）支撑。 场景整体布置在主通道右侧。
instruction_en: Create an AGV-to-conveyor handoff scene: place conveyor in an east-west orientation, put pallet on the rear-right side of the conveyor infeed, place box on pallet, place part on conveyor, and park agv outside pallet facing the conveyor. Set support relations: box is supported by pallet; part is supported by conveyor. Place the whole scene on the right side of the main aisle.

instruction_zh: 构建一个机器人检测工位：workbench位于中心区域，Industrialrobot放在workbench的正前方并朝向台面，conveyor位于workbench后方，box放在conveyor上，保证机器人与台面之间无碰撞。 设置支撑关系：part（零件）由workbench（工作台）支撑；box（箱体）由conveyor（输送线）支撑。 场景整体布置在主通道右侧。
instruction_en: Create a robot inspection workstation: place workbench in the central area, put Industrialrobot on the front side of workbench facing the tabletop, place conveyor behind workbench and put box on conveyor, and keep the robot clear of the bench. Set support relations: part is supported by workbench; box is supported by conveyor. Place the whole scene on the right side of the main aisle.

instruction_zh: 构建一个货架拣选场景：rack沿仓储通道一侧放置，pallet位于rack的后方作为临时集货点，box放在rack下层货位，box放在pallet上，forklift停在pallet前方并与货架保持安全距离。 设置支撑关系：box（箱体）由rack（货架）支撑；box（箱体）由pallet（托盘）支撑。 场景整体布置在主通道右侧。
instruction_en: Create a rack picking scene: place rack along one side of the storage aisle, put pallet on the rear side of rack as a staging point, place box on the lower bay of rack, place box on pallet, and park forklift in front of pallet with a safe gap to the rack. Set support relations: box is supported by rack; box is supported by pallet. Place the whole scene on the right side of the main aisle.

instruction_zh: 构建一个包装下线工位：conveyor平行于货架通道连接来料方向，workbench放在conveyor的左侧用于包装，agv停在workbench外侧用于转运成品，并让台面与输送线边缘保持可取放距离。 设置支撑关系：part（零件）由conveyor（输送线）支撑；box（箱体）由workbench（工作台）支撑。 场景整体布置在主通道右侧。
instruction_en: Create a packing offload station: align conveyor in an parallel to the rack aisle orientation for incoming items, place workbench on the left side of conveyor for packing, park agv outside workbench for finished-goods transfer, and keep the bench within reachable distance of the conveyor edge. instruction_en: Create a robot loading buffer area: place pallet in front of Industrialrobot, place part on pallet, put rack on the right side of Industrialrobot, place box on the lower bay of rack, and orient the robot toward the work area between pallet and rack.
